name: salt-syntax
description: Syntax highlighting, coloring and IntelliSense for SaltStack SLS files (YAML + Jinja2)
author: naqoyqatsi83

saltSyntax.prependSlsToStateId.markdownDescription: When inserting a full state block from module completion (e.g. typing `file.` and picking `managed`), prepend `{{ sls }}.` to the generated state ID: `{{ sls }}.<state_id>:`. Disable to just insert `<state_id>:` instead.

saltSyntax.showWhitespace.markdownDescription: Render whitespace (`editor.renderWhitespace`) in `.sls` files — spaces as `·`, tabs as `→`. Disabling this writes an explicit `"[sls]"` override in your settings restoring VS Code's own default (`selection`); re-enabling removes that override again.

saltSyntax.enforceLfLineEndings.markdownDescription: Enforce LF line endings (`files.eol`) in `.sls` files regardless of platform. Disabling this writes an explicit `"[sls]"` override in your settings restoring VS Code's own default (`auto`); re-enabling removes that override again.

saltSyntax.enforceFinalNewline.markdownDescription: Ensure every `.sls` file ends with exactly one trailing blank line on save (`files.insertFinalNewline` + `files.trimFinalNewlines`). Disabling this writes explicit `"[sls]"` overrides in your settings restoring VS Code's own defaults (both `false`); re-enabling removes those overrides again.

saltSyntax.jinjaWhitespaceControl.markdownDescription: Include Jinja's `-` whitespace-control marker on the opening side of `{% %}` blocks this extension inserts (e.g. via `if`/`for`/`set` completion) — `{%- if %}` instead of `{% if %}`. Off by default.

saltSyntax.smartTopLevelDetection.markdownDescription: When completing a module (e.g. typing `file.` and picking `managed`) with some leading indentation, insert the full `{{ sls }}.<state_id>:` block and reset it to the start of the line unless the line directly above is actually a valid, unindented state declaration to nest under. Disable to always use strict indentation instead (0 spaces = full block, any indentation at all = function stub only, nested under whatever is above).

saltSyntax.nonAsciiCheck.markdownDescription: Warn about non-ASCII characters anywhere in `.sls` files (comments included) — smart quotes, en/em dashes, non-breaking spaces, accented letters and the like, typically pasted in from docs or chat — since older Salt minions (Python 2 based, or running under a non-UTF-8 locale) can fail to render a file containing them. Each warning offers a quick fix replacing it with an ASCII equivalent where one exists; **Salt Syntax: Convert Non-ASCII Characters to ASCII** converts the whole file at once.

saltSyntax.jinjaIndentCheck.markdownDescription: Warn when a Jinja `{% %}` tag's indentation doesn't follow block nesting: every tag inside a block should be indented two spaces deeper than the block's opening tag, and a block's own `elif`/`else`/`end...` tags level with its opening tag — so an `{% if %}` inside a `{% for %}` can't sit at column 0 and read as if it were outside the loop. Only tags that start their line are checked; each warning offers a quick fix to re-indent it, or every flagged tag in the file.

enumDescriptions: Indent the new line two spaces deeper than the innermost open Jinja block (top level: same indentation as the tag line), so the next tag lands where the Jinja indentation check expects it.
Always start the new line at column 0.
saltSyntax.jinjaEnterIndent.markdownDescription: Where the cursor goes after pressing Enter at the end of a line that starts with a Jinja `{% %}` tag. Enter after any other line (YAML) keeps VS Code's normal auto-indent. Relies on `editor.formatOnType`, which this extension turns on for `.sls` files by default.

enumDescriptions: Salt 3008.x (Argon) and newer — the current stable line.

Salt 3006.x — Salt's long-term-support line. Still includes many state modules (mostly third-party cloud/provider integrations such as most boto_*, libcloud_*, zabbix_*, and pagerduty_* states) that 3008.x dropped when their dependencies were split out into separate salt-extensions packages.
saltSyntax.saltVersion.markdownDescription: Which Salt release line's state modules/functions to offer in `module.function:` completions. Pick `3006` if your minions are still on the 3006.x LTS line and you need completions for a state module that 3008.x no longer ships. Can also be switched via the **Salt Syntax: Set Salt Version** command.
